info.title: SAS Viya MCP
info.description: Gives Microsoft Copilot Studio agents tools for a SAS Viya environment through the SAS Viya MCP Server: discover CAS and library tables, profile columns, query data with FedSQL, and run SAS code. Every call runs as the signed-in SAS Viya user.

post.description: Sends a JSON-RPC 2.0 message to the SAS Viya MCP Server over Streamable HTTP. Microsoft Copilot Studio handles the MCP protocol; this operation is not meant to be called directly.

200.description: MCP Streamable HTTP response (JSON or text/event-stream).

401.description: Unauthorized: the SAS Viya access token is missing, expired or not accepted by the server.
